notes.title: DON'T WATCH – ENDING SONG & THANK YOU
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/ddea2f64068e0ccc06b522648ec303313f44c7fa.png[/img]

We still can’t believe it… The second title in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][b]BrokenLore saga[/b][/url] is finally out!

Your support has been absolutely incredible—thank you from the bottom of our hearts. We’ve poured so much into this project, and seeing your reactions, messages, and love means the world to us.

And this is just the beginning—our next game, which will also be the longest title in the series so far, is coming soon.

To celebrate the release, I’m sharing the ending song of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/][b]BrokenLore DON’T WATCH[/b][/url], which many of you have asked for. I’m so happy you enjoyed it and that it resonated with you.

[previewyoutube=Jl1X5gcnF4g;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you again for being part of this journey...

notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUCEMENT
notes.notes:

notes.title: New Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to have finally given you a glimpse of [b]BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH[/b], and we really hope you’ve enjoyed the demo. On top of that, we’re happy to announce that the demo for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/][b]BrokenLore: LOW[/b][/url] is now live as well! Don’t miss the chance to dive into this new chapter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/

A quick clarification for those exploring the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][b]BrokenLore[/b][/url] series: each game can be experienced as a standalone story, and you don’t need to have played the others to enjoy it fully. However, for those who play all the titles, you'll uncover the overarching narrative and piece together the larger lore behind this complex story.

Our decision to work on multiple titles and release them just a few months apart is purely driven by storytelling reasons. We wanted to maintain narrative focus and avoid diluting the experience. We hope you understand and appreciate this creative choice. Meanwhile, there are already four demos available from the series (including [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133830/UNFOLLOW/][b]UNFOLLOW[/b][/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2846530/FOLLOW/][b]FOLLOW[/b][/url]), so if you haven’t played them yet, be sure to give them a try—and don’t forget to add them to your wishlist!

Now, to celebrate Steam Next Fest, we’d also like to highlight another game that we think you’ll love: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376200/KARMA_The_Dark_World/][b]Karma: The Dark World[/b][/url]. This psychological thriller has a highly cinematic feel and is set in a dystopian version of East Germany in 1984, ruled by the Leviathan Corporation. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1376200/KARMA_The_Dark_World/

Investigate the twisted environments of suspects memories and the horrors that lurk within the corners of their minds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/d235e17ad74528a26b147a7ac1dcefe9337bf90b.jpg[/img]

Test your sanity as the boundaries between reality and the surreal blur together – can you trust what you see and keep your sense of self?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/f30e1c1ce732ddb7633595c9d317caebe32bdf3c.jpg[/img]

Lose yourself in a cinematic interactive story, that explores the themes of family, love, loss and control – where a simple investigation leads to a world of espionage and betrayal, littered with deep and dark secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/b46f263a69be19df987324db6c20f119c8588964.gif[/img]

We encourage you to wishlist it, check out the demo and admire the stunning visuals we’ve shared. 
As always, thank you so much for your incredible support!

Join us: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini]Serafini Productions[/url]
